fullPassage: Ever since I was young, I have admired great public speakers. I hoped to inspire and move audiences like them someday. But every time I had a chance to speak in front of people, I would get scared. I didn't want to make a fool of myself. This fear kept me behind the stage rather than on it. That's why I never entered the annual speech contest at my school. I really wanted to, but I just didn't have enough courage. Last year, however, was my final chance before graduating. I decided to sign up for the contest. To make a long story short, I did it. But my act of courage taught me a valuable lesson: ____________________.

questions.passage: One evening, I went to a convenience store to buy some snacks. No one was at the counter, so I thought the clerk <u>ⓐ was working</u> in the back. The telephone started <u>ⓑ ringing</u>, but no one came to answer it. I felt something was wrong. I looked over the counter and saw the clerk <u>ⓒ lying</u> on the floor. I immediately called 911 and <u>ⓓ explaining</u> the situation. The operator asked me <u>ⓔ to perform</u> CPR on the clerk until the paramedics arrived.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중에서 어법상 어색한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 나는 즉시 911에 전화를 걸어 상황을 설명했다. called와 explained는 and로 연결된 병렬 구조로 둘 다 과거형이어야 합니다. explaining(현재분사)은 병렬 구조에 맞지 않으므로 explained로 고쳐야 합니다.
det.analysis: 원문: I immediately called 911 and explained the situation.
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

I fell to the ground and had to (C) <u>be carried / carry</u> off the track.

det.korean: 이것은 나의 고민과 두려움에서 도망치는 것을 멈출 기회였다. 마음을 먹고 지원했다. 용기 있는 결정 덕분에. (A) overcome → overcame(과거형): 부상을 극복했다. (B) brave: 용기 있는 결정
det.analysis: 원문: This was my chance to stop running away from my problems and fears. So I made up my mind and applied to this major. Thanks to my brave decision.

questions.passage: I decided to sign up for the contest. To make a long story short, I did it. I delivered my speech to the entire school. But my act of courage taught me a valuable lesson: I can do anything that I put my mind to.
questions.stem:

[보기] teach / I / a valuable lesson / my act / courage

→ "나의 용기 있는 행동은 나에게 값진 교훈을 주었다."

det.analysis: 원문: But my act of courage taught me a valuable lesson.

det.korean: 교환원은 나에게 점원에게 심폐소생술을 해달라고 요청했다. ask + 목적어 + to부정사 구문에서 perform은 to perform으로 변환해야 합니다.
